// Scratch generator of repository-flow-sankey.json, not built by this repo. From a detached acr
// worktree at the contract commit, then `go run ./cmd/zzsankey <this directory>`, then
// `prettier --write` on the output (whitespace only; the JSON is unchanged). Ran at acr a60efd6c: the
// tip of the PR that adds the table (#1962), which holds the pin of record (26237a42) and the table's
// declaration. Each table's column words come from that real declaration (ZZWithDeclaredColumnWords).
//
// No producer emits this rule yet (CHAOS-12582), so the shape is built here the way acr's own
// contract test builds it (`chaos12578_sankey_shape_test.go`): one series per theme with effort,
// labelled with `ContextFabricInvestmentThemeLabel`, one point per link with effort, labelled with
// the repository's word. What makes it served is the rest: acr's real `ServeVocabularyLabels`,
// `Validate` (which runs `validateSankeyShape`) and `json.Marshal`. Refresh it from the real selector
// when CHAOS-12582 lands.

// internal/contextfabric/zz_sankey_export.go
package contextfabric

import (
	"time"

	contractsv1 "github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-acr/internal/contracts/v1"
)

type ZZSankeyLink struct {
	Repository, Word, Theme string
	Effort                  float64
}

// Scratch only (CHAOS-12579), never committed: a full team result whose claim holds a declared
// repository_theme_breakdown table, and the sankey that plots it.
func ZZSankeyResult(links []ZZSankeyLink) InvestigationResult {
	totals := map[string]float64{}
	for _, link := range links {
		totals[link.Theme] += link.Effort
	}
	rows := make([]ClaimedFactRow, 0, len(links))
	for _, link := range links {
		repository, word, theme, effort, total := RepositoryCanonicalID(link.Repository), link.Word, link.Theme, link.Effort, totals[link.Theme]
		rows = append(rows, ClaimedFactRow{Fields: map[string]ScalarValue{
			"repository": {String: &repository}, "repository_label": {String: &word}, "theme": {String: &theme},
			"weighted_effort": {Number: &effort}, "theme_weighted_effort": {Number: &total},
		}})
	}
	const claim = "claim_investment_team_repositories"
	series := []contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderSeries{}
	for _, theme := range []string{ThemeFeatureDelivery, ThemeOperational, ThemeMaintenance, ThemeQuality, ThemeRisk} {
		points := []contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderPoint{}
		for index, link := range links {
			if link.Theme != theme || !(link.Effort > 0) {
				continue
			}
			row := index
			points = append(points, contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderPoint{Label: link.Word, Value: link.Effort, Source: contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderPointSource{
				Kind: contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderSourceClaimedFactRow, ClaimID: claim, RowIndex: &row, Field: "weighted_effort",
			}})
		}
		if len(points) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		word, _ := contractsv1.ContextFabricInvestmentThemeLabel(theme)
		series = append(series, contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderSeries{Key: theme, Label: word, Points: points})
	}
	basis := "work_unit_investments"
	team := SubjectRef{Kind: contractsv1.ContextFabricSubjectTeam, CanonicalID: TeamCanonicalID("platform"), Label: "Platform"}
	result := InvestigationResult{
		SchemaVersion: InvestigationResultSchemaV1, ResultID: "result_sankey_0001", RequestID: "request_sankey_0001",
		GeneratedAt: time.Date(2026, 11, 2, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), Status: InvestigationComplete,
		Question: "Where is the Platform team's effort going, by repository?",
		Interpretation: InterpretedQuestion{
			Shape: ShapeSingleSubject, RequestedJudgment: "allocation",
			TimeContext:      TimeContext{Axis: TemporalCurrent},
			FactRequirements: []FactRequirement{{Kind: FactInvestment}},
		},
		SubjectResolution:   SubjectResolution{Candidates: []SubjectCandidate{}, Committed: []SubjectRef{team}},
		DirectJudgment:      "The team's effort leans to feature delivery in acme/web.",
		CurrentState:        "Most of the team's effort appears to go to feature delivery.",
		StrongestPressures:  []string{},
		Drivers:             []DriverJudgment{},
		RemainingWork:       []Finding{},
		ReadinessGaps:       []Finding{},
		Paths:               []RelationshipPath{},
		Conflicts:           []Finding{},
		Limitations:         []string{},
		EvidenceRefIDs:      []string{},
		Coverage:            Coverage{Sources: []SourceObservation{}, DegradedReasons: []string{}},
		Versions:            VersionSet{ServiceVersion: "test-v1", ContractVersion: InvestigationResultSchemaV1, Backend: "test"},
		DeterministicAnswer: "The team's effort leans to feature delivery in this window.",
		Warnings:            []string{},
		AnswerPlan: &contractsv1.ContextFabricAnswerPlan{
			Family: QuestionFamilyInvestmentAllocation, FamilyVersion: QuestionFamilyTableVersion,
			FamilySource: contractsv1.ContextFabricQuestionFamilySourceModel, Budget: contractsv1.ContextFabricAnswerPlanBudget{MaxItems: 400, MaxSerializedBytes: 262144, MaxMembers: 1, SynthesisHeadroom: 40, NarrowingBasis: contractsv1.ContextFabricNarrowingBasisCanonicalIDLexical},
			RenderKinds: []contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderKind{contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderKindSankey, contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderKindTable},
		},
		ClaimedFacts: []ClaimedFact{{
			ClaimID: claim, Kind: FactInvestment, Field: "attribution_basis", Value: ScalarValue{String: &basis}, Rows: rows, Subject: team,
			Table: &contractsv1.ContextFabricClaimedFactTable{
				Field: "repository_theme_breakdown", Shape: contractsv1.ContextFabricFactTableShapeBreakdown, Key: []string{"repository", "theme"},
				Measures: []string{"weighted_effort", "theme_weighted_effort"}, Observations: []string{"repository_label"},
			},
		}},
		RenderShapes: []contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderShape{{
			ShapeID: "rs_1", Kind: contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderKindSankey, SelectedBy: contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderRuleInvestmentRepositoryFlow,
			Title: "Effort by repository and theme", AxisKind: contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderAxisCategory,
			AxisLabel: "Repository", ValueLabel: "Weighted effort", Series: series,
		}},
	}
	result.Completeness = ComputeAnswerCompleteness(result)
	return result
}

// ZZWithDeclaredColumnWords states each claimed table's column words from the producers' own
// declarations, the step finalizeResult runs (withDeclaredColumnWords, declaredColumnWordsOf).
func ZZWithDeclaredColumnWords(result InvestigationResult, capabilities []FactCapability) InvestigationResult {
	result.ClaimedFacts = withDeclaredColumnWords(result.ClaimedFacts, declaredColumnWordsOf(capabilities))
	return result
}

// cmd/zzsankey/main.go
// Scratch only (CHAOS-12579): acr's real vocabulary labels, Validate and encoder.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-acr/internal/contextfabric"
	"github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-acr/internal/contextfabric/devhealthfacts"
)

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

func main() {
	result := contextfabric.ZZSankeyResult([]contextfabric.ZZSankeyLink{
		{"0b6f6a52-6c0e-4f7e-9d0b-3a1f2f6f0001", "acme/web", "feature_delivery", 40},
		{"0b6f6a52-6c0e-4f7e-9d0b-3a1f2f6f0001", "acme/web", "quality", 10},
		{"0b6f6a52-6c0e-4f7e-9d0b-3a1f2f6f0002", "acme/api", "feature_delivery", 25},
		{"0b6f6a52-6c0e-4f7e-9d0b-3a1f2f6f0002", "acme/api", "maintenance", 0},
		{"0b6f6a52-6c0e-4f7e-9d0b-3a1f2f6f0002", "acme/api", "operational", 5},
		{"0b6f6a52-6c0e-4f7e-9d0b-3a1f2f6f0003", "acme/infra", "maintenance", 12.5},
		{"0b6f6a52-6c0e-4f7e-9d0b-3a1f2f6f0003", "acme/infra", "quality", 2.5},
	})
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("contracts/examples/v1/context_fabric_investigation_result_render_shapes.v1.json")
	must(err)
	var example contextfabric.InvestigationResult
	must(json.Unmarshal(raw, &example))
	result.Versions = example.Versions
	// The producers' real declarations state each table's column words (CHAOS-12639).
	var capabilities []contextfabric.FactCapability
	for _, provider := range devhealthfacts.NewProviders(nil) {
		capabilities = append(capabilities, provider.Capability())
	}
	result = contextfabric.ZZWithDeclaredColumnWords(result, capabilities)
	served, tier := contextfabric.ServeVocabularyLabels(result, true, 262144)
	must(served.Validate())
	encoded, err := json.MarshalIndent(served, "", "    ")
	must(err)
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Args[1], "repository-flow-sankey.json"), append(encoded, '\n'), 0o644))
	fmt.Printf("tier=%s shapes=%d bytes=%d\n", tier, len(served.RenderShapes), len(encoded))
}
